decisions.behavior: Reveal up to3, compare creature-face costs only; one/two remaining cards can match. Choose deployment order, including non-evolution before evolution. Protect the batch in its library so EX-life uses the first non-revealed card. Unplaceable cards stay at top on a match; a miss is bottom-ordered. Each entry replacement finishes before the next entry.

Capture simultaneous shield-to-hand after all shield removals. Declare after all ST declarations and before any ST execution, then resolve among ordinary triggers after ST cards, rechecking zero shields and the same hand zone serial. Non-break acquisitions also work. This ability is not blocked by ST-only suppression.

Only empty-library defeat is prevented; direct attacks can still lose. EX-life can remove the last library card while BigBang enters. Replace each draw individually with optional grave deployment; replacement is not an actual draw. Complete the replacement before the next draw or later effect. Source removal/ignoring at empty library causes defeat before pending triggers.

Own-turn private top peek. Normal paid creature summons from the top in main, with evolution bases and entry replacements. No spell-face casting from this permission. Next top card is excluded from opponent observations and online projections; controller can inspect from mobile menu or online private card info.

Ryu replacement checks that the cause is an opposing creature or spell, independent of whose turn. All existing discard tasks retain cause controller, while Baiken keeps its separate enemy-turn condition. Discard batches reserve identities first and replacement cards are never counted as actually discarded.
